quotes.text: The cardholder’s bank, not Stripe, decides the outcome of each dispute.

An issuer might use this reason code for a centrally acquired domestic transaction, or a domestic transaction processed through the Mastercard network, where a chargeback is available according to the applicable domestic rule but can’t be processed under a different message reason code. This reason code is applicable to Europe region transactions only.
**Documentation supporting the validity of the charge:** Any evidence demonstrating the charge was legitimate and compliant with applicable domestic rules.
Local payment methods (LPMs) don’t use card network reason codes. Instead, each LPM provider defines its own reason codes based on the types of disputes on its platform.
